# dsh-agent-whale-girl

An unofficial **whale-girl (鲸鱼娘) companion** for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
She replaces the side

bar brand mark and floats over the page as a draggable,
collapsible mascot: her head follows your cu

rsor, she reacts to pats and clicks,
she follows what the agent is doing, and her speech bubble repo

rts the current
session's real token usage.

> The character is community fan art, not an official DeepSeek asset — see
> Source & attribution. C
hinese docs: README.zh.md.
## What she does
| Area | Behaviour |
| Sidebar brand mark (`sidebar.brand.mark`) | Replaces the stock fish logo with a close-up of her fa

ce (`avatar-face.png`). Registered with `priority: -1` so it wins the single-value slot. |
| Floatin
g companion (`shell.overlay`) | A 220×298 paper doll over the frame, with a token card above her and
speech bubbles. Drag her anywhere inside the frame (position kept in `localStorage['whale-girl:posi
tion']`); double-click returns her to the bottom-right corner and forgets the position; when the win

dow shrinks she is folded back into view. |
| Gaze | Her head turns towards the pointer (up to ±7°)
and her tail counter-swings (±4.8°); both settle back to centre 0.22 s after the pointer leaves. The

pivot is measured from the eyes/lashes in the art, not from the bounding box. |
| Pat | Press and h
old ≥ 350 ms: a one-shot squash-and-return animation plus a dedicated line. She does **not** fold aw

ay. |
| Click and combo | A quick click (< 350 ms) folds or unfolds her, with an answering line; 3–4

fast clicks get a counted complaint; the 5th click fires a one-shot easter egg. |
| Mood | `data-mo
od` follows context occupancy: `<50%` `calm`, `≥50%` `tense`, `≥85%` `crit`. Each crossing drops a 💦

in her corner for 2.6 s. |
| Speech | Lines are triggered by state and filled with real numbers fro
m DSH's own session projections (`tokenUsage`, `contextPressure`): a greeting on mount, an answer on
click, live progress while the turn is producing output, a context warning at 80 %, and a "done" li

ne 2.5 s after output stops. She never calls the network or the model. |
| Token card | Context occu
pancy (bar plus `tokens / window`) and output / input / cache-read counts for the current session —
the same projections the composer's own indicator uses. Hidden when there is no session; it yields w

hen the window is narrower than 900 px. |
| Three-layer puppet | Her body, head and tail are separat
e layers that are pixel-identical to the still illustration at rest, so they are invisible until she
that are pixel-identical to the still illustration at rest, so they are invisible until she moves. |

Animations run only while she is being interacted with: exactly three one-shot
`@keyframes` (`wg-pat

` / `wg-egg` / `wg-emote`), no `infinite`, no `alternate`,
no `will-change`; `getAnimations()` is em

`wg-emote`), no `infinite`, no `alternate`,
no `will-change`; `getAnimations()` is empty when idle.

## Build and verify

`lib/client.js` and `lib/client.css` are committed, so installing needs no build
step. To rebuild af
ter changing the art or the skeleton:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`verify-bundle.cjs` is a structural and behavioural self-check (registrations,
injected CSS, layer g

eometry, gaze maths, click/pat/combo timing, mood values).
Use absolute paths — the script resolves

the bundle relative to the working
directory.
## Files
| File | Purpose |
| `package.json` | Declares `dsh.bundle.patch` (installable bundle) and `dsh.client.platform = "web"

` (browser half). |
| `index.js` | Host half: an intentionally empty `apply()` so the loader can mou

nt the package. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The mount declaration read at install time. |
| `lib/client
.js` / `lib/client.css` | Build output: the client bundle that registers both slots, and the stylesh

eet it injects. |
| `build.mjs` | Builds the two files above from the PNGs and `layers.json` (inline

s the art, writes the skeleton geometry into CSS). |
| `layers.json` | Puppet skeleton: crop boxes,

rotation origins in the 414×560 art space, amplitudes, measured pivots. |
| `verify-bundle.cjs` | Se

lf-check. |
| `avatar-body.png` / `avatar-head.png` / `avatar-tail.png` | The three puppet layers. |

| `avatar-face.png` | 96×96 face crop used by the 24 px mark and the folded bubble. |
| `avatar.png

` | The full-body illustration before cutting. |
| `assets/` | Source art. |
